parsed.name: WebDAV文件项
parsed.description: WebDAV文件服务中的单个文件资源，用于在实验室网络或集群存储中公开数据文件。可用于查看文件属性并通过HTTP/WebDAV传输原始数据，如显微图像、分析结果或实验记录。
parsed.description_en: A single file resource in a WebDAV file service, used to expose data files on lab networks or cluster storage. It is used to inspect file properties and transfer raw data over HTTP/WebDAV, such as microscopy images, analysis outputs, or experiment records.

actions.description: 获取该WebDAV文件项的属性信息。
actions.description_en: Get the properties of this WebDAV file entry.

actions.description: 发送该文件的数据内容给客户端。
actions.description_en: Send the file data to the client.
